description.value: Osoyoos Produce is a Vancouver neighbourhood Chinese grocery store with over two decades of service, specializing in authentic ingredients including fresh daily vegetables, live seafood, hand-pulled noodles, fermented sauces, and traditional teas. Located on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver, it serves the local Chinese community with a curated selection of specialty and everyday pantry items. A touring cyclist passing through the area would find a wide range of fresh produce and packaged goods for resupply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an operating Chinese grocery store at 5723 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC with phone (604) 568-7122, matching the OSM address. The site lists fresh produce, meat, seafood, noodles, sauces, teas, and snacks as product categories, confirming basic groceries. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
